PROJECTS

POWER APPS & POWER AUTOMATE

Railcar Safety and Compliance Management System – ChemCore Industries

Role: Power Platform Developer | Duration: Jan 2025 – Sep 2025 Technologies: Canvas App, Power Automate, SharePoint and Azure-AD

Project Overview:

Developed a Power Apps Canvas app to manage safe loading and unloading of hazardous chemical railcars. Operators scan or enter a railcar number and complete digital checklists—pre- operation, loading, and post-operation—with photo capture and supervisor signature. All data is stored in SharePoint, creating a full audit trail, and Power Automate sends instant alerts if any critical step fails. This paperless system improves safety, compliance, and real-time reporting for chemical railcar operations.

Key Contributions:

Designed Canvas App forms for digital railcar safety checklists. • Integrated SharePoint for compliance and inspection data storage. • Implemented conditional validations to enforce safety protocols. • Configured Power Automate flows to send alerts on non-compliance. • Created audit logs with inspector details, timestamps, and approvals. • Enabled role-based access for inspectors, supervisors, and admins.

Corporate Room Scheduling Application – GulfStar Energy Solutions

Role: Power Platform Developer | Duration: May 2024 – Nov 2024 Technologies: Canvas App, Power Automate, Dataverse and Azure-AD

Project Overview:

Developed a Corporate Room scheduling application using Microsoft Power Apps. It allows employees to view available rooms, check details like capacity and equipment, and book rooms in real time. The app stores room and booking data in Dataverse and integrates with Office 365 Outlook, so every confirmed booking automatically updates the shared calendar and prevents double-booking. I focused on a clean, mobile-friendly UI and built validations to block past dates and overlapping time slots.

Key Contributions:

Design overall solution with Power Apps and Dataverse. • Use Dataverse to store Metadata about rooms and meeting information. • Integration with office365outlook so booking correspond to actual calendar entries. • Develop the flow to get room resources (email, names) and automatic updating room metadata into the Dataverse table.

UI/UX concerns like blocking past times, showing current date, ensuring valid times are • selectable, showing Today’s booking and upcoming bookings using Interactive gallery. • Implemented Role based Permissions (some can add rooms, others only book rooms). • Creating Security groups (using Azure-AD), Creating custom Security role and assigning this role to the security group (Dataverse Level). Involved in Solution Deployment (Dev-UAT-production).



Vehicle Tracking and Maintenance Application – GulfStar Energy Solutions

Role: Power App Developer | Duration: Nov 2022 – Jun 2023 Technologies: Canvas App, Power Automate, Dataverse and Azure-AD

Project Overview:

Developed a Power Apps Canvas App to manage a company’s entire vehicle fleet. It stores vehicle, driver, assignment, usage, and maintenance data in Dataverse, gives managers a dashboard screen to monitor data and automate notifications and compliance checks with Power Automate. Drivers can log trips and fuel usage on mobile, while managers can assign vehicles and track maintenance in real time.

Key Contributions:

• Performed form-level customizations and managed enterprise-level solutions. • Built Power Apps forms and screens using Power Fx with collections & variables. • Dataverse for Data storage and security roles. • Power Automate flow sending reminder (compliance expiration date) and sending Email. • Azure-AD for Authentication and role-based access control. • Language and technology: Canvas App, Power Automate, Dataverse and Azure-AD.

Involved in Complete development of this Application.

E-Voting and Poll Management Application – NBC Bearings (National Engineering Industries Ltd.)

Role: Power App Developer | Duration: Jun 2022 – Sep 2022 Technologies: Canvas App, Power Automate, SharePoint and Office365

Project Overview:

I created an internal E-Voting system using Microsoft Power Apps Canvas App to run secure organizational elections like employee polls and award voting. Users log in with their Microsoft 365 account, view ongoing elections, and can vote only once per election, with options for anonymity. Admins set up elections and candidates, while Power Automate sends reminders and vote confirmations. All votes and audit logs are stored in SharePoint, ensuring data security, transparency, and accurate results without paper or manual counting.

Key Contributions:

• • • • Power Automate flow to send election announcements, Reminders and vote confirmations.

Involved with complete development of this Project SharePoint list as the Data source. Login and role management using Microsoft365 identity. Election setup and candidate management for admins.

Employee Onboarding and Access Request Management System – SinoCloud Technologies.

Role: Power App Developer | Duration: Dec 2021 – May 2022 Technologies: Canvas App, Power Automate, SharePoint and Office365

Project Overview:

Developed a Power Apps Canvas App with SharePoint as a backend to automate the Employee Onboarding and Access Request Management System. The app auto-fills user details, applies conditional rules based on hire type, validates contract dates, and on submission, stores data in SharePoint and sends confirmation emails via Power Automate. This reduced manual effort and streamlined onboarding for both employees and vendors.

Key Contributions:

Requirement Gathering and Analysis. • Client Communication and End to End Delivery. • One of the key features was that if the logged-in user was raising a request for himself, his details got automatically populated using Office365 connector. If the user was to submit on behalf of someone else, then he could select the username from dropdown most of the details would auto populate, while some fields like Name and Reporting manager remained editable. There were also conditional rules.





Once the request was submitted, the data was saved into a SharePoint list, and a power



automate flow was triggered to send confirmation Email to the requestor. Solution Design and involve with the Team for every aspect of development.

COPILOT STUDIO

DeskMate – Smart Helpdesk Copilot – NextGen IT Services

Role: Power Platform Developer | Duration: Aug 2023 – Dec 2023 Technologies: Copilot Studio, Dataverse, MCP Server, Adaptive Cards, Power Automate.

Project Overview:

Developed an autonomous Helpdesk Copilot Agent for internal employees to raise and track IT support requests using natural language. The agent parses issue descriptions, auto-creates Tickets in Dataverse, assign priority, and provides real-time updates by integrating with an MCP Server and knowledge sources.

Key Contributions:

Built Agent Flow with AI reasoning and Tool Actions (Dataverse + Email connector). • • Used adaptive cards for response summaries and ticket status updates. • • Enable multilingual support and transcript-based debugging. Technology: Copilot Studio, Dataverse, MCP Server, Adaptive Cards, Power Automate.

Integrated MCP Server to retrieve agent context for open/pending tickets.

MediBot – Doctor Appointment Scheduler – SATA CommHealth

Role: Power Platform Developer | Duration: Jan 2024 – Mar 2024 Technologies: Copilot Studio, Dataverse, MCP Server, Adaptive Cards, Power Automate.

Project Overview:

Developed an AI-powered Doctor Appointment Scheduling Copilot that allows patients and staff to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments using natural language through a web interface. The bot integrates with Dataverse to store patient and doctor schedules.MediBot bridges the gap between user and SATA CommHealth.

Key Contributions:

Used Customed trigger to initialize the bot conversation.

Used Dataverse as a Tool to add booking details. • Used Prompt Builder to structure the quote summary logic. • Orchestrated response generation using Tool Action and AI steps.

POWER AUTOMATE CLOUD FLOW

➢ HR Recruitment: Enter bulk candidate data from Excel to SharePoint with Power

Automate.

➢ Company Car Order Form: Perform Overall end to end approval process with SharePoint

➢ ➢

and Power Automate. Integration of SharePoint and Dataverse for Files. Integration of On-Premises file system and Dataverse files to sync HIPPA, PHI and compliance data.

➢ SQL Server On Premise and SharePoint Sync via Cloud flows. ➢ Connect to Web APIs, Rest APIs with Custom Connector. ➢

Integration of Power Apps and Power Automate: Pass data from Power Apps to call custom connector through the cloud flow using parameters of JSON.

➢ Autoreply to training inquiry. ➢ Creating Teams invites. ➢ Apply OData Query in Power Automate with SharePoint. ➢ Working with more than 5000 items in SharePoint and Dataverse.

Strong foundation in Azure AD, Office 365, and Power Platform integrations.
